Each ally within 12 squares of the high judge can then make a [free strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.main-actions/free-strike) against a target of the high judge's choice. Each creature charmed by All Rise, Compel the Jury, or Devilish Suggestion makes a [free strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.main-actions/free-strike) against a target of the high judge's choice.
